main.description: Return an offline-verifiable proof bundle for a name: its full signed mutation chain (oldest-first) plus the current head's trust tier. Proves content, order, and non-alteration offline; authority is NOT included — a verifier that wants to check authorship must be supplied the capability chain separately, because the server never holds it.

headTier.description: ADR-0008 trust tier of the current head record (0 = legacy/operator-signed, 1 = self-custody). Informational; the verifier re-derives per-record tier by decoding unsignedBytes.
